name: Fencing VR: En Garde Arena
summary:
Step onto the virtual piste! Experience the world's most elegant combat sport with unparalleled realism in Fencing game.

Powered by a realistic fencing physics , every parry, lunge, and touché feels authentic. Master the blade in a true test of wits, reflexes, and strategy.

KEY FEATURES:

MASTER 3 DISCIPLINES: Duel against advanced AI opponents in Foil, Épée, and Sabre to perfect your technique in every style.
